visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male character with short brown hair and glasses is seen in a medium close-up, using black chopsticks to lift a large portion of wavy yellow noodles from a white ceramic bowl. He opens his mouth wide to take a bite. The background is a brightly lit indoor living space with a white sofa and a framed abstract painting on the wall. (2) Close-up view of a blue and white product packet labeled 'DIAMOND OF SEA' being squeezed, pouring dark brown soup, large chunks of beef, and a carrot slice into a bowl already containing noodles. (3) A top-down shot shows two white bowls of beef noodle soup on a white surface. One bowl features tomato slices and thin beef strips, while the other contains thick chunks of beef and translucent tendon pieces. (4) A female character with long black hair is shown from the nose down, eating a piece of beef with black chopsticks in a bright indoor setting. (5) The male character is seen again, drinking the brown soup from a stainless steel spoon and then giving a thumbs-up gesture to the camera. He continues to eat noodles vigorously. (6) Wavy noodles are being boiled in a stainless steel pot on a black induction stove. The product packets are then placed into the boiling water to heat up. (7) A young boy and girl are shown together behind several red and black boxes of the product. They have their mouths open in a cheerful shout, looking directly at the camera in an indoor home setting. (8) The female character pours the beef and soup from the packet into a bowl. Finally, chopped green onions are sprinkled over a prepared bowl of beef noodle soup, highlighting the finished dish.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with a friendly, conversational tone at a moderate pace, narrating the experience of eating. An upbeat acoustic guitar and light percussion track plays in the background. A distinct, wet slurping sound is heard as noodles are consumed. (2) The sound of a liquid pouring into a bowl creates a splashing acoustic texture, synchronized with the visual of soup being added. The background music remains constant in tempo and volume. (3) The narrator continues with moderate pitch variability and clear articulation, describing the texture of the beef. A faint metallic clink of a spoon hitting a ceramic bowl is audible. (4) A soft bubbling and boiling sound of water is heard, followed by the crinkling noise of a plastic and foil packet being handled and squeezed during the cooking demonstration. (5) Sudden high-arousal cheering from children breaks the narrative flow, characterized by sharp, high-pitched vocal bursts and laughter. (6) The male narrator returns with a persuasive, enthusiastic tone, concluding the video with a call to action. The music maintains its major-mode, positive atmosphere until it fades out as the video ends.
